case.summary: An alert was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.79 on card C02502-K2 for in-person transaction 3611043 totaling $3,008.76. The bank's calibrated second-generation model scored the transaction at 0.001 with an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.63%. The activity occurred in region 123, which is the cardholder's primary region representing over half of historical volume, and mirrors an earlier transaction of $3,025.17 in the same category without anomalous flags. Furthermore, previous large-dollar model alerts on this account and similar profiles have consistently cleared as legitimate cardholder spend. The alert is confirmed as a false alarm, and the case is closed as legitimate with no fraud.
